items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions Lionel Halton in relation to 'Dwight' (the interviewee's father), not the interviewee directly. The interviewee does not respond with personal connection.

ctx.x: Dwight was his father and he was a piano player.

Yeah, and he's one of the better trumpet players during that time, you know, that came along. I've never met anybody. He's still going strong, yeah. He knows a lot of people. I think he's playing with Lionel Halton I think. No, he's still with the cop.
